svg.title: Strata's layers and where each runs
svg.desc: From World Bank open data up to the screen: the data, the knowledge model, the tools, the agent, the verifier and the app, each marked by where it runs.

g.text: World Bank open data, read every night
Unity Catalog tables, an edge table,
fixed SQL on the gold tables, hybrid search,
writes claims with their evidence IDs
runs each tool as the viewer
language models: Azure OpenAI, through Foundry
